wo-jpfa-JR5261.d:
PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu)

Job Responsibilities
* Monitor, operate, and maintain all machinery and auxiliary equipment
* Conduct regular preventive maintenance and routine inspections to identify and resolve potential equipment failures before they occur.
* Troubleshoot and repair mechanical, electrical, or pneumatic malfunctions promptly to minimize production downtime.
* Collaborates closely with the production team to optimize line efficiency and ensure output meets quality and safety standards.
* Maintain accurate logs of maintenance activities, equipment repairs, and parts inventory.
* Adhere strictly to company safety protocols, Quality Assurance guidelines, and 5S workplace organization standards.

Job Qualifications
* Proven experience as a maintenance technician or operator in a manufacturing or processing plant, preferably within the food or feed industry.
* Strong technical knowledge of mechanical systems, pneumatics, hydraulics, and basic electrical troubleshooting.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, equipment manuals, and electrical schematics.
* Good problem-solving skills, physical stamina, and the ability to work effectively in a shift-work environment.
* Strong commitment to workplace safety, teamwork, and discipline.
